$comment: The hand-written half of this project's manifest. Everything else -- the systems, their folders, extensions and browse mode, the firmware ABI, sizes and hashes -- is derived from the packed core by scripts/make_manifest.py. Nothing derivable belongs here.

description.en: The 8 KB ColecoVision boot ROM, read from /bios/coleco/coleco.bin. The ColecoVision ROM folder is col but its BIOS folder is coleco, so the two keys differ. This core also carries a copy of the boot ROM inside its own binary, so games run without the file present.
